name: green-zone-series-bars
note: `bars=` from an input, the right-edge counterpart of green-zone-series-offset. An HTF projected candle is drawn at `left = bar_index + projOffset + slot*spacing` and `right = left + width`, so BOTH edges move with a setting; leaving `bars` const while `offset` became a series means x1 can overtake x2 and the box collapses or inverts. Here off=2 and span=5 with the zone spawning at bar 2, so the box runs bar 4 to bar 7 -- and bars 5..7 do not exist in this 5-bar dataset, which is the point: a projected candle lives entirely past the last bar and its anchors carry `ahead` rather than a time.
source:
indicator("H", shorttitle="H", overlay=true)
off = input.int(2, "Off", minval=0, maxval=50)
span = input.int(5, "Span", minval=1, maxval=50)
plotzone(bar_index == 2, high, low, "P", offset=off, extend=extend.bars, bars=span)
